transformations.edit: Replaced the seed string recorder with an executable Verus function whose body preserves the Rust 1.96 target shape `let n = needle.len(); self.len() >= n && needle == &self[..n]`, adapted only by naming the receiver parameter `slice` and isolating the prefix comparison as a named source-backed boundary.

Modeled the second conjunct `needle == &slice[..n]` as target-local `rust_1_96_needle_eq_slice_prefix`, carrying only the generated prefix relation when the Rust length guard establishes `n <= slice.len()`. This records the frozen slice range expression plus the slice PartialEq / SlicePartialEq::equal_same_length implementation without externalizing the public target.

Added the generated `slice_is_prefix` / `partial_eq_observed` vocabulary as the Verus ensures clause on the target and the narrow prefix-comparison boundary; this records the contract under test and does not use assume_specification.
